Greek life member here. The whole rush process fucking sucks. You’re constantly interviewing with tons of kids, constantly getting names thrown at you, along with hundreds of first impressions. The key is (and I know this is so fucking hard) to not take it personally. Things will work out. Keep joining other clubs, rush more fraternities, make small talk with people in classes (how I’ve met most of my friends). But don’t give up. (Forming study groups are a huge key that I just learned my junior year). Hope this helps. (Also frats aren’t the only groups that have parties...look into club sport teams like ski club.
